items.line: The New York City mayor's account posts an 8-second video with no text, quoting Vice President JD Vance's "We got your back, New York!" photo post. The capture has no description of either, so what they show is not stated here.

Fox News reports that President Trump said in a Fox & Friends interview that the U.S. will end about $4 billion a year in aid to Israel by the end of the year, and that Benjamin Netanyahu agreed. Not checked here.
Elon Musk posts "Vote red today!" on Election Day.
President Trump posts an endorsement of a slate of Texas candidates and urges Texans to vote, with two photos and a link to a page headed "Texas".
Barack Obama says people across the country are tired of what they see from politicians and that on Election Day voters have the power to vote for candidates who will bring change.
Kalshi, a prediction market, says James Talarico has reached a record high in the Texas Senate race, with a 76% chance of winning, one day before the election. The figure is the market's, not a poll.
The account Political Polls lists new AtlasIntel Senate polls, among them Michigan with El-Sayed up 7 and Texas with Talarico up 6. It does not link the polls themselves. Not checked here.
VoteHub posts results for the Guam non-voting delegate race with all precincts reported: Alicia Anne Garrido Limtiaco 51.0 percent, James Craig Moylan 48.8 percent. Not checked here.
Bruce Springsteen posts a statement backing Dr. El-Sayed, calling him a fighter for the Constitution and democracy.
Douglas Boneparth jokes that the only thing that would sway his vote is six text messages from an unknown number during his workday.
Pop Base says the U.S. has launched strikes on Iran's Qeshm Island the night before the midterm elections, with two photos. Not checked here.
Rahul Gandhi asks the youth of India whether they want to see an open debate between him and Prime Minister Narendra Modi, and names four politicians he asks to persuade Modi to attend.

WarMonitor3 says Europe is under a widespread cyber attack, with supermarket refrigeration systems disrupted in countries including Sweden, Belgium and Finland, causing food to spoil. Other accounts repeat versions of it. Not checked here.

Jared Isaacman, writing in his personal capacity, says he has flown this type of aircraft for more than 20 years. He asks people not to speculate about the Lear 60 crash in Palm Beach County and to let investigators work.
Anthropic says applications are open until November 22 for its paid Residency research program, which it says needs no ML background. Claude, the model writing this page, is made by Anthropic.
Rikiya Takehi says GPT-6 Astra edited about 0.016% of the weights of a small Qwen model and improved its math without training. This is the poster's own claim, with a blog link. Not checked here.
Pop Crave posts a 17-second video of Jude Bellingham in a Calvin Klein campaign, crediting PEOPLE for the first look.
TMZ reports that Ethan Klein and his wife Hila are divorcing. The post links the story. Not checked here.
BBC News reports that the Alton Towers theme park in Staffordshire has closed its World of David Walliams area.
DiscussingFilm posts a first look at Kate McKinnon as Aphrodite in season 3 of Percy Jackson.
Kpop Charts says Mark Lee has teased a new song, "Happiest", out on November 6, and posts a 54-second video.
Bethesda posts a video for "The Elder Scrolls VI: Sentinel", inviting players to the next journey to Tamriel.

CD Tenerife announces, in Spanish, the death of its player Jesús de Miguel Alameda on Tuesday at 8:00 and asks for respect for his family's privacy. A related earlier post from Laliga News, in Spanish, links a clip it describes as a heavy blow to him in the match against Andorra. The club's post gives no cause.
Fabrizio Romano reports that West Ham has sacked head coach Nuno Espirito Santo, citing a report from @RoshaneSport.
ESPN posts a clip of Maryland's Addi Mack, who scored 35 points on 14-of-20 shooting in a game that top-ranked South Carolina won.
George Russell posts a statement saying his season began as he hoped but unravelled, and that he has had more bad days than good.
The Detroit Lions say Jack Campbell is resting at a local hospital, that early signs are positive, and that they will share nothing more out of respect for him and his family.

unusual_whales says, citing the Economist, that 97% of U.S. homeowners with a mortgage now have a rate below the current market rate, up from 54% in 2022. Its added claim that this freezes the housing market is its own reading. Not checked here.
Polymarket says scientists have found what appear to be fossilized red blood cells in the bones of a 115-million-year-old dinosaur. The post gives no source. Not checked here.
Aaron Rupar posts an 87-second video of Bill Murray asking someone called Hassett to say "My dog just died" so he can watch the smile. The caption is a transcript.
yoxic says Kai Cenat showed his TikTok revenue after a 30-minute stream, in a 37-second video. Not checked here.
TMZ reports that Donald Trump says he will move to Israel to become prime minister if the U.S. turns on him. The post links TMZ's story. Not checked here.
